meta.note: Values are the live All white look (html[data-look=white]) measured on the running hub, which overrides index.css where they differ.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Names, figures, titles, row leads and every word a person reads first. 16.8:1 on `canvas`, 14.1:1 on `stone`.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Ordinary cell and body text. The same ink as `ink` in this look; ask for `text` when the word is content, `ink` when it is a name or a figure.

tokens.name: body
tokens.usage: Everything that supports a name: labels, captions, column headings, units, the line under a row's name. 5.1:1 on `canvas`, 4.9:1 on `band`, 4.5:1 on `soft-2`.

tokens.name: mute
tokens.usage: Counts after a tab, crumbs, a fact's label. The same grey as `body`: quieter is a colour, never a smaller size.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Disabled glyphs and the empty dash's quiet cousin. 1.7:1 on `canvas`, so never for a word anyone has to read.

tokens.name: crumb-sep
tokens.usage: The slash between crumbs in a sheet head (`Purchase Orders / PO-…`). Decoration only, 2.2:1.

tokens.name: line-ico
tokens.usage: Icons beside words and the search box's placeholder. 3.3:1 on `canvas`: enough for a glyph, below 4.5:1 for text, so a placeholder never carries information.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The page, a sheet, a card, a field. The one surface everything is read on.

tokens.name: soft
tokens.usage: A quiet fill: a note box before white.css turns it white, a skeleton's base.

tokens.name: soft-2
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed wash for ghost and quiet buttons, × and nav rows; the photo tile behind a thumbnail; the chip round a filter's word.

tokens.name: soft-3
tokens.usage: The lightest wash: a switch's off track, a grouped-grey background.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: A framed table's heading row and its totals row, 40px tall.

tokens.name: segment-track
tokens.usage: The track of a Segmented control; the chosen segment is `canvas` on it.

tokens.name: row-line
tokens.usage: The hairline between table rows and between rows of a list (`divide-y`).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Card and table frames, the rule under a page head and a sheet head, the rule over a sheet foot, KPI dividers. 1.2:1: it separates, it never encloses a control on its own.

tokens.name: hairline-2
tokens.usage: The border of a control: ghost buttons, fields, the search box, the Filter button. 1.4:1 on `canvas`, below the 3:1 a control boundary asks for; the field's label and its 40px height carry it.

tokens.name: hairline-strong
tokens.usage: The strongest rule: a column group divider in a dense table.

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: The shell's ground: what shows round the floating page and the screens panel. Never a content surface.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: The screens panel, a white sheet 216px wide floating on `stone`.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The veil behind a sheet, always with a 2px backdrop blur. Nothing in Central darkens: no black scrim anywhere.

tokens.name: tooltip
tokens.usage: The tooltip chip, the one dark surface in the chrome. `on-dark` words on it.

tokens.name: dark
tokens.usage: A dark surface where one is drawn: the legacy charcoal rail and door. In the white look the door's half is white with grain, so `dark` is nearly unused. Never an action colour.

tokens.name: on-dark
tokens.usage: Words and glyphs on `tooltip`, `dark`, `cta`, `bad-fg` and `brand-tile`.

tokens.name: rail-text
tokens.usage: A department icon in the outer rail. 8.8:1 on `stone`.

tokens.name: rail-mute
tokens.usage: A rail label at rest. 6.4:1 on `stone`.

tokens.name: rail-hover
tokens.usage: The wash under a rail icon or panel row under the pointer.

tokens.name: rail-tile
tokens.usage: The department you are in: a white 40px tile on `stone`, its icon in `accent`.

tokens.name: panel-ink
tokens.usage: The department's name at the top of the screens panel (`panel-title`). 14.7:1 on `panel`.

tokens.name: panel-body
tokens.usage: A screen's name in the panel. 10.5:1 on `panel`.

tokens.name: panel-mute
tokens.usage: A group label in the panel (the 12px chip labels). 5.0:1 on `panel`.

tokens.name: panel-hover
tokens.usage: A panel row under the pointer.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Selection and nothing else: the screen you are on, a chosen tile, the focus ring, a word that opens another record (`record-link`). 5.4:1 on `canvas`, 4.9:1 on `accent-bg`, 4.5:1 on `stone`.

tokens.name: accent-bg
tokens.usage: The selection wash: the active row in the screens panel (words in `accent`, weight 600), a chosen choice tile, a switch row that is on.

tokens.name: cta
tokens.usage: The one solid primary button per surface: New order, Save changes, Review Count. `cta-fg` words, 5.4:1.

tokens.name: cta-hover
tokens.usage: The primary button under the pointer. 6.6:1 with `cta-fg`.

tokens.name: cta-fg
tokens.usage: Words and glyphs on `cta`.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 2px halo round a focused field, with its border turning `accent`. Buttons and links take a 2px solid `accent` outline instead.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: A good state's dot or glyph, always beside its word. 2.6:1: never alone, never text.

tokens.name: ok-bg
tokens.usage: A good note's wash (a saved receipt). Rare in the white look.

tokens.name: ok-fg
tokens.usage: A good state's word where the word itself is toned: the one Pill in a sheet head (Active, Fully received), a toast's tick, a button that says it saved. In a list the word stays `ink` and only the dot is `ok`. 4.4:1 on `canvas`, a hair under 4.5:1: kept exact from the source; the dot and the word together carry it.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: A state that waits on somebody: its dot. 3.0:1, never alone.

tokens.name: warn-bg
tokens.usage: A waiting note's wash.

tokens.name: warn-fg
tokens.usage: A waiting state's word, in a list and in a Pill alike (Pending, Draft, Partially received), and a quiet remainder (40 pcs short). 4.4:1 on `canvas`, a hair under 4.5:1: kept exact; 3.7:1 on `warn-bg`.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: A problem's dot, an invalid field's border, the required asterisk.

tokens.name: bad-bg
tokens.usage: A problem note's wash (a failed save above a foot).

tokens.name: bad-fg
tokens.usage: A problem's word (Cancelled, Rejected, a late date) and the fill of a Cancel or destructive button with `on-dark` words (5.4:1); the red count badge. 5.4:1 on `canvas`, 4.6:1 on `bad-bg`.

tokens.name: bad-hover
tokens.usage: A red button under the pointer. 6.9:1 with `on-dark`.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: In motion and only that (shipped, in transit, receiving): its dot. Never selection; that is `accent`.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: An in-motion note's wash.

tokens.name: info-fg
tokens.usage: An in-motion state's word in a sheet head's Pill (In transit, Issued, Processing); in a list the word stays `ink` and only the dot is `info`. 5.4:1 on `canvas`.

tokens.name: new-fg
tokens.usage: The New marker on a record nobody has opened yet. 4.2:1: a short word beside a dot, never a sentence.

tokens.name: new-bg
tokens.usage: The New marker's wash where one is drawn.

tokens.name: a-orange
tokens.usage: Chart series and identity tiles only, never chrome.

tokens.name: a-green
tokens.usage: Chart series and identity tiles only, never chrome.

tokens.name: a-blue
tokens.usage: Chart series and identity tiles only, never chrome.

tokens.name: a-pink
tokens.usage: Chart series and identity tiles only, never chrome.

tokens.name: a-violet
tokens.usage: Chart series and identity tiles only, never chrome.

tokens.name: fill-green
tokens.usage: A chart's filled area or bar in the good series.

tokens.name: fill-sky
tokens.usage: A chart's filled area or bar in the in-motion series.

tokens.name: fill-orange
tokens.usage: A chart's filled area or bar in the waiting series.

tokens.name: app-home
tokens.usage: Home's icon tile on the phone launcher (Apps tab) and nowhere else.

tokens.name: app-executive
tokens.usage: Executive's launcher tile only.

tokens.name: app-merchandise
tokens.usage: Merchandise's launcher tile only.

tokens.name: app-inventory
tokens.usage: Inventory's launcher tile only.

tokens.name: app-ops
tokens.usage: Operations' launcher tile only.

tokens.name: app-marketing
tokens.usage: Marketing's launcher tile only.

tokens.name: app-buying
tokens.usage: Procurement's launcher tile only.

tokens.name: app-selling
tokens.usage: Sales' launcher tile only.

tokens.name: app-finance
tokens.usage: Finance's launcher tile only.

tokens.name: app-finance-new
tokens.usage: The new Finance's launcher tile only.

tokens.name: app-hr
tokens.usage: People's launcher tile only.

tokens.name: app-ga
tokens.usage: General Affairs' launcher tile only.

tokens.name: app-library
tokens.usage: Library's launcher tile only.

tokens.name: app-reports
tokens.usage: Reports' launcher tile only.

tokens.name: app-system
tokens.usage: System's launcher tile only.

tokens.name: brand-tile
tokens.usage: The app icon's matte blue tile (Matte · Deep, 20 Oct): #4277e6 at its top to #1f4fc0 at its foot, behind a pale C and a yellow dot. This is its middle, for a flat fill.

tokens.name: avatar-from
tokens.usage: A person's initials avatar: the wash's first stop.

tokens.name: avatar-to
tokens.usage: A person's initials avatar: the wash's last stop.

tokens.name: space-a
tokens.usage: Time travel's virtual clock only: the pale end of its field. Violet means this time is not real.

tokens.name: space-mid
tokens.usage: Time travel's virtual clock only: the ramp's middle.

tokens.name: space-b
tokens.usage: Time travel's virtual clock only: the violet at the clock.

tokens.name: space-core
tokens.usage: Time travel's virtual clock only: the clock's disc, white hands on it (8.0:1).

tokens.name: space-ink
tokens.usage: Words on the virtual clock's field. 12.3:1 on `space-a`.

tokens.name: space-ink-2
tokens.usage: Smaller words on the virtual clock's field.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono Variable", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: panel-title
styles.usage: The department's name at the top of the screens panel, in `panel-ink`. The one size above the title, and it is chrome.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: A page's title and a sheet's title, in `ink`. One per surface. Never 22–28px.

styles.name: lead-figure
styles.usage: The one figure on a phone card (`CardFigure`), its unit in `label` beside it. Phone cards only.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: A KPI figure under its label, in `ink`, tabular. The same on a page and in a sheet.

styles.name: card-name
styles.usage: The record's name at the top of a phone card (`CardName`), its number and facts under it in `label`.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: A section's title inside a sheet or a form, its count after it in `mute`.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Every cell, fact value and sentence. The size of the whole app: nothing on a screen is smaller.

styles.name: body-medium
styles.usage: The name that leads a table row, a tab's word, a column heading (in `body`).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: A KPI label, a field label, a sheet caption, the phone band sentence — in `body`/`mute`.

styles.name: crumb
styles.usage: The crumb over a sheet title and a fact's label (`Fact`), in `mute`.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: A ghost or quiet button's word, a nav row, a field's typed value.

styles.name: control-strong
styles.usage: A primary or red button's word, and the active row in the screens panel.

styles.name: count
styles.usage: The white number in a red count badge, tabular.

tokens.name: page-gutter
tokens.usage: A page's side padding on a desk, and a sheet's head, body and foot side padding: the title, the figures, the bar and the table share this edge.

tokens.name: phone-gutter
tokens.usage: Side padding on a phone, for the page, the cards and the sheet drawer.

tokens.name: page-top
tokens.usage: Above a page head and above a sheet head's crumb.

tokens.name: head-bottom
tokens.usage: Under a page title or a sheet title, before the head's hairline.

tokens.name: head-gap
tokens.usage: From the page head's hairline to the figures.

tokens.name: figure-pad
tokens.usage: Each side of a KPI figure; the hairline divider sits between two pads. The first figure lines up with the title, no rule.

tokens.name: figures-to-tabs
tokens.usage: Under the KPI strip, before the tabs.

tokens.name: tab-gap
tokens.usage: Between two tab words.

tokens.name: tabs-to-bar
tokens.usage: Under the tabs' hairline, before the bar.

tokens.name: bar-gap
tokens.usage: Between controls in the bar: search, Filter, a date, Columns.

tokens.name: bar-to-table
tokens.usage: Under the bar, before the framed table.

tokens.name: cell-x
tokens.usage: A table cell's side padding, heading included.

tokens.name: cell-y
tokens.usage: A table cell's top and bottom padding.

tokens.name: float
tokens.usage: How far the page, the screens panel and a sheet stand off the window; also the step a layer stands further in over the sheet under it.

tokens.name: sheet-body-top
tokens.usage: From a sheet head's hairline to its first section.

tokens.name: sheet-body-bottom
tokens.usage: Under a sheet's last section, before the foot.

tokens.name: foot-y
tokens.usage: A sheet foot's top and bottom padding round its 36px buttons.

tokens.name: section-gap
tokens.usage: Between sections in a sheet body (`stack`) and between field rows in a form.

tokens.name: facts-gap-x
tokens.usage: Between the two columns of `Facts`.

tokens.name: facts-gap-y
tokens.usage: Between rows of `Facts`.

tokens.name: label-gap
tokens.usage: From a field's label to its box; from a crumb to the title it sits over.

tokens.name: fact-gap
tokens.usage: From a fact's label to its value, and from a KPI label to its figure.

tokens.name: icon-gap
tokens.usage: Between a button's glyph and its word.

tokens.name: dot-gap
tokens.usage: Between a status dot and its word.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Every control in a bar and every button on a desk: search, Filter, dates, Columns, New order, a foot's verbs.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: A form field's box on a desk.

tokens.name: tap
tokens.usage: The touch floor: every button, field and foot verb under a finger (pointer: coarse); the Fab; the phone foot buttons.

tokens.name: card-button
tokens.usage: The one button at the foot of a record card (`Button size=card`); its hit area grows to 44px with a pseudo-element.

tokens.name: board-step
tokens.usage: The step button on an Ops board card (`board-act-btn`).

tokens.name: table-head
tokens.usage: A framed table's heading row and a sheet's items heading.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: The least height of a one-line table row; two-line rows grow to their content (about 73px).

tokens.name: sheet-foot
tokens.usage: A sheet foot's least height on a desk.

tokens.name: nav-row
tokens.usage: A screen's row in the screens panel.

tokens.name: rail-button
tokens.usage: A department's icon button in the outer rail.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: The outer rail's width.

tokens.name: panel-width
tokens.usage: The screens panel's width.

tokens.name: search
tokens.usage: The search box's width at most, in the bar.

tokens.name: sheet-rail
tokens.usage: `size="rail"`: a record of ten facts or fewer, or a form of eight fields or fewer. The only sheet that stands beside its list on a wide monitor.

tokens.name: sheet-wide
tokens.usage: `size="wide"`: a document with lines (PO, supplier, return, article). 1040 from a 1440 window, 960 at 1280, all but 80px of a tablet.

tokens.name: sheet-table
tokens.usage: `size="table"`: a grid read across (receiving count, pool, SKU matrix).

tokens.name: sheet-workspace
tokens.usage: `size="workspace"`: a list and the work beside it (New articles, Import, a campaign).

tokens.name: dot
tokens.usage: A status dot.

tokens.name: count-badge
tokens.usage: A red count badge's height and least width.

tokens.name: switch-w
tokens.usage: A switch's track width (18px tall).

tokens.name: r-inner
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, the search box, nav rows, menus' rows, the × button.

tokens.name: r-chip
tokens.usage: A small outlined tag (a code, a category, a contract type).

tokens.name: r-card
tokens.usage: Cards, framed tables, phone cards, an order's items box, a rail button.

tokens.name: r-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheets, the floating page and the screens panel; the phone drawer's top corners.

tokens.name: r-segment-track
tokens.usage: A Segmented control's track.

tokens.name: r-segment
tokens.usage: The chosen segment on the track.

tokens.name: r-link
tokens.usage: The focus outline round a `record-link`.

tokens.name: r-full
tokens.usage: Round things only: status dots, avatars, count badges, a switch, the Fab. Never a button or a tag.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: A sheet floating over the veil (`--wt-ring`). The edge is the ring, not a border.

tokens.name: shadow-page
tokens.usage: The white page floating on `stone`.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: The screens panel floating on `stone`.

tokens.name: shadow-rail-tile
tokens.usage: The white tile of the department you are in.

tokens.name: shadow-primary
tokens.usage: Under the solid primary button, and only there.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, a select's list.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The phone's bottom drawer and other glass that floats over everything.

tokens.name: shadow-segment
tokens.usage: The chosen segment on a Segmented track.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: A focused field's halo (with an `accent` border).

tokens.name: shadow-board-hover
tokens.usage: An Ops board card under the pointer.

duration.note: Motion tokens from index.css. Frequency decides the budget: a hover is instant, a sheet may explain where it came from.

tokens.name: t-press
tokens.usage: A press: `scale(0.97)` on :active, ease-out.

tokens.name: t-hover
tokens.usage: Every hover colour, and what a bare `transition` utility runs at.

tokens.name: t-pop
tokens.usage: A tooltip or a popover opening.

tokens.name: t-page
tokens.usage: One screen replacing another (the view transition).

tokens.name: t-panel
tokens.usage: A dropdown, a select, the panel folding.

tokens.name: t-sheet
tokens.usage: A sheet sliding in from the right on a desk (the layer move), with `ease-drawer`.

tokens.name: t-exit
tokens.usage: Everything leaving: a sheet, a drawer, the veil. Out is faster than in.

tokens.name: t-drawer
tokens.usage: The phone's bottom drawer rising the full height.

tokens.name: t-swap-in
tokens.usage: The mode move: a sheet's contents fading in after Edit (sheet.tsx `swap`).

tokens.name: t-swap-out
tokens.usage: The mode move: a sheet's contents fading out before they swap.

tokens.name: t-spring
tokens.usage: The spring's own length, only ever with `spring`: the account orb springing back, a stamp pressed in front of you.

easing.note: Emil Kowalski's curves, exactly. Never ease-in on UI.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Anything entering or leaving, presses and hovers.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Something already on screen moving to a new place (the panel folding).

tokens.name: ease-drawer
tokens.usage: Glass that travels the width or height of the window: a sheet, the phone drawer.

tokens.name: spring
tokens.usage: A spring, bounce about 0.15, over `t-spring`: a released drag's follow-through, a stamp's rubber giving as it hits.
